newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: SOCCER-BOLIVIA'S CASTILLO TO MISS REST OF COPA AMERICA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOLIVIA'S CASTILLO TO MISS REST OF COPA AMERICA.

text.p: Bolivia's Ivan Castillo will miss the rest of the Copa America soccer tournament after suffering a rough tackle which resulted in the sending-off of Peru's Jose Reyna during Sunday's group B match.
Bolivia doctor Omar Rocha said Reyna's studs caused an eight centimetre-deep cut that exposed tendons and led to extensive bleeding.
Castillo, stretchered off in obvious agony, will not be able to play again until July, Rocha said.
Despite Castillo's injury, Peru coach Freddy Ternero said Reyna's sending-off was harsh.
"It spoiled our work and stopped us from doing what we had planned," he complained.
